Both files include `from __future__ import annotations` for Python 3.9 compatibility. The heuristic baseline was smoke-tested and works correctly (returns the intentionally naive last-mention number).

- `src/sage/baselines/__init__.py`: created, 0 bytes (empty file)

- `src/sage/config.py:31-33`: EvalConfig references `direct_baseline_checkpoint` — confirms baselines are expected

- `/Users/lxxfysl/Projekte/SAGE/src/sage/baselines/__init__.py` — created empty init file
- `/Users/lxxfysl/Projekte/SAGE/src/sage/baselines/direct_answer_model.py` — created with `DirectAnswerModel` class (load, answer, answer_batch, load_checkpoint) + `from __future__ import annotations`
